def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits within 8 bits; the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post k != 0 or out == x
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(255, 3) == 255
    ex rotl8(5, 0) == 5
    low = x & (255 >> k)
    return (low << k) | (x >> ((8 - k) % 8))
